answer: The mirror index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1527 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ferrous. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the forge queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. That is 39 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
